subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept `qwen-token-plan` as a bundled provider inside the existing qwen plugin, or should Token Plan support stay external until demand and ownership are clearer?
rationale: The code fits the qwen plugin boundary and has live proof, but it adds provider/config/auth surface that VISION.md treats as high-bar bundled plugin/product scope.

options.title: Accept bundled provider after repair
options.body: Land the provider once the branch is rebased and the guided setup manifest metadata is fixed.

options.title: Route to external plugin
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish Token Plan support through ClawHub or an external plugin package instead of expanding bundled qwen surface now.

options.title: Pause for more demand
options.body: Keep the issue/PR open but wait for maintainer or user demand before accepting a new bundled provider id.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled provider after repair
recommendation.body: Land the provider once the branch is rebased and the guided setup manifest metadata is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the most recent qwen catalog and guided onboarding changes and is the current assignee.
